meta.name: AI & Cybersecurity — Mirror's Edge Theme
meta.inspiration: Mirror's Edge: bright reflective surfaces, sense of distance/scale/grandeur, blue + white

navy.role: dark card fill / quote & closing background

blueMid.role: secondary accent, kicker on light bg

sky.role: light gradient base / subtitle text on dark

ice.role: light card fill / divider gradient mid

white.role: dominant background, headline text on dark

cyan.role: sharp accent — kickers on dark, stat numbers

colorUsage.dominance: White / near-white carries 60-70% of visual weight across the deck as a whole; navy gradients are reserved for title, section-opening quote, and closing slides.
colorUsage.cardRule: On a white-background slide, cards stay LIGHT (ice/white fill, hairline border, colored kicker/icon for differentiation). Dark navy fill is reserved for slides that are themselves full-bleed dark (stat callouts, quote slides, closing) — never as a card sitting on a white slide.

headingFont.slidevSuggestion: Space Grotesk or Archivo Expanded for a closer futuristic web-font match, fallback Arial

motif.usage: Single repeating accent anchor before a kicker/title on divider, title, quote, and closing slides. Fill = blue @ 10-25% transparency, stroke = cyan 1pt. Replaces underlines/accent bars (avoided by design system rule).

lightCard.usedWhen: card sits on a white/light-background slide
lightCard.fill: #F5F8FF (or #EAF2FF for a second differentiated card in the same row)

darkFullBleed.usedWhen: the entire slide is the card — stat callouts, quote slides, closing

usedOn: decorative accent on agenda / stat slides, right or left edge, 30-100% opacity

geometrySource: assets/tokens/background-geometry.json — raw gradient stops, glare radial-gradient params, perspective line coordinates, and facet polygon point lists used to generate every SVG above. Re-derive CSS gradients/clip-paths directly from this file rather than eyeballing the SVGs.
